evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/q/a owns two 256-int arrays plus the classic ISAAC count/accumulator/counter state and accepts the seed int[] in its constructor.
Its generation round applies the characteristic ISAAC 13-left, 6-right, 2-left and 16-right xor shifts, 256-entry indirection, accumulator/counter update and result production.

Initialization uses eight accumulators seeded with -1640531527 (0x9e3779b9), performs the standard repeated ISAAC mixing sequence, folds in the seed/results array, then generates the first result block.
Public 317 client sources preserve this exact implementation under the class name ISAACRandomGen, including the 256-word memory/results arrays and golden-ratio initialization constant.

proposals.note: Recovered original legacy 317 ISAACRandomGen identity from exact algorithm/source fingerprint, not merely a descriptive crypto name.
